items.q: When is it time to leave the job?
items.a: When the waitlist is about **10× the clients you need** and the prices are real. Need **30**, have **300**. Keep about **six months** of savings. His own bar was **750**. About **4,500** joined.

items.q: What is a business, on this tape?
items.a: **Demand**, not a thing you are ready to supply. The page states the offer, the difference, the value, and proof. Five questions: situation, outcome, what failed, **price**, and an open note.

items.q: How do you fill the list from zero?
items.a: Daily **short form**, one **long form of about 6–60 minutes**, then the list. Turn the winner into an ad. Offline, **sign the street up before you buy the mower**. AI, including ScoreApp, makes the page cheap.
